name: Download All
summary: Adversaries may execute a full program download to a PLC to overwrite the entire PLC program and configuration to deploy a new project or make major changes. This typically requires stopping the PLC and adversely impacting control processes. The ability to perform a full program download to the PLC typically relies on access to a workstation with the vendor-specific PLC programming software installed.

analytics.name: Analytic 2056
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol session reading back the complete program, configuration, and data block set from a field device in a single session from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, distinguished from a partial Program Upload by the comprehensiveness of the read. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect.…
